# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.5.3

Version 1.5.3 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.5.2

**In multiplayer, a villager in a talk stops for everyone.** Until now a talk was each player's own: the villager
stood still in front of the player talking with it, and walked on in everyone else's game. Now:

- when a guest talks with a villager, the host's villager goes to where it stands in that guest's game (at once when
  it is far off or out of sight), stops and turns to that guest, in its talk pose, until the talk is over; the other
  guests follow the host's villager as always, so everyone sees it stand there talking;
- when the host talks with a villager, the guests' villager stops right where the host's stands, turned to the host,
  in its talk pose.

What is said stays on the screen of the player who talks.

**Everyone sees and hears the other players' actions as they look in their own game.** The other players' puppets
already played their animations; now what those actions make in the world comes with them:

- digging: the dirt flying up, the hole opening, a buried item flying out of the ground; filling a hole: the dirt
  and the hole closing;
- shaking a tree: the tree shaking (leaves falling) and the fruit falling from it and rolling;
- an item dropped from the hand, falling to the ground;
- the dust, splashes, ripples and footprints of walking, running and standing in water, the axe's chips, the net's
  and rod's swings, and the other effects of the player's actions;
- the sounds of those actions (the shovel, the tree, picking up, ...), from where the puppet stands.

The items themselves still come from the acting player's game, as before; what is shown here only looks and
sounds like it. Bees from a shaken tree stay each game's own.

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's: v1.5.2 and v1.5.3 can be in the same room (the talks and actions
  above are shown between v1.5.3 players). 32-bit and 64-bit players can play together, whatever graphics API each
  uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.3-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.3-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.3-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.3-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Known limitations

- The talk itself (what is said, the choices) is only on the talking player's screen; the others see the villager
  stop and turn to that player.
- Two players talking with the same villager at once each have their own talk; the host's villager stays with the
  host's.
- The limitations of v1.5.2 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.5.2)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
